manifest.latency_classification: faster/slower only beyond both 25% and 50ms; raw values always retained; no statistical-significance claim
limits: instrumented loopback timings; source CPU excludes observer CPU
macOS memory metric is GoSys, not RSS
Loki cache state retained per request, no cold-Loki claim
one static fixture, no production workload distribution claim
owner0 loss affects only keys on owner0; backup-hit metrics verify actual fallback
manifest.network_bytes_scope: client-to-observer HTTP message bytes including headers/framing and encoded bodies; excludes TCP/IP, retransmissions, observer-to-target second hop
manifest.observers: stdlib keep-alive HTTP proxies before VL and peer HTTP, same addresses in every trial
manifest.recent_fixture_scope: RecentEnd is immutable setup time, not necessarily near-now at execution; per-request end age and default 120s recent-tail/24h metadata freshness eligibility are recorded; no fresh-ingestion claim
manifest.startup_scope: request-phase zero-VL statements exclude separately recorded startup health/version traffic; default startup warmers may read VL
manifest.vl_counts_scope: fleet aggregate; per-node backend observer URLs would change backend-auth cache keys
manifest.window_scope: historical base ends 30m before seeded history ends; forward refresh advances by 60s into previously unrequested windows; sequential phases share caches, not isolated cache-state trials

limitations: Sequential phases share cache state; forward historical windows are unseen but not isolated cold-state experiments.
Recent fixture age is recorded per response; it is not a current-ingestion proof.
Instrumented same-host loopback; HTTP counters cover client-observer message hop only, excluding IP/TCP/retransmissions and observer-target second hop.
All-response phase counters are authoritative; concurrent per-response counter intervals overlap.
L2 metric/file lengths are physical bbolt high-water, not logical admitted bytes.
No single-query distributed execution or production linear-scaling claim.
Practical latency threshold is both 25% and 50ms; no statistical significance claim.
